DatasetShareRelationship.description_en: The configuration for sharing a dataset

AllowedMountAccessLevels.description_en:
The allowed permissions for the shared dataset. When a user accesses the shared dataset, their permissions are limited to this list. The default value is \`\["RO"]\`.

RO: Read-only permission. The recipient can only read the dataset.

RW: Read and write permission. The recipient can read and modify the dataset
AllowedMountAccessLevels.description_zh:
分享时指定允许的权限范围，使用被分享的数据集时权限将会被限制在此列表范围内。缺省为["RO"]。
RO: 只读权限，被分享方只能读取数据集内容。
RW: 读写权限，被分享方可以读取和修改数据集内容
AllowedMountAccessLevels.title:
分享时指定允许的权限范围，使用被分享的数据集时权限需在此列表范围内
● RO: 只读权限，被分享方只能读取数据集内容
● RW: 读写权限，被分享方可以读取和修改数据集内容

ExpiresAt.description_en:
The expiration time. The time is in ISO 8601 format.

If you do not specify this parameter, the sharing relationship never expires
ExpiresAt.description_zh:
过期时间，ISO 8601格式。

如不填写则表示永不过期
ExpiresAt.title: 过期时间，ISO 8601格式

Extra.description_en:
Additional configurations for the sharing relationship. This parameter is a JSON string.

AllowExportModel: Specifies whether to allow the export of trained models.

AllowAccessDLCWebTerminal: Specifies whether to allow users to log on to the container in a DLC task.

AllowAccessDLCFullLog: Specifies whether to allow access to the full task logs
Extra.description_zh:
分享补充配置。json string格式。
AllowExportModel：是否允许训练后的模型导出
AllowAccessDLCWebTerminal：打开/关闭DLC任务中的登录容器的权限
AllowAccessDLCFullLog：打开/关闭全量展示任务日志的权限

IsSecureMode.description_en: Specifies whether to enable security protection for the shared dataset
IsSecureMode.description_zh: 是否需要对分享的数据集开启安全防护
IsSecureMode.title: 是否需要安全防护

SharedAt.description_en: The time when the dataset was shared. The time is in ISO 8601 format
SharedAt.title: 分享时间，ISO 8601格式

SourceTenantId.description_en: The ID of the tenant that owns the source dataset. The user who shares the dataset must be a workspace administrator or the root account
SourceTenantId.description_zh: 源数据集租户ID。分享者需为该工作空间管理员或者主账号身份
SourceTenantId.title: 源数据集租户ID

SourceWorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace that contains the source dataset
SourceWorkspaceId.title: 源数据集工作空间ID

Status.description_en:
The status of the sharing relationship.

ACTIVE: The sharing relationship is active. Complete dataset information is displayed only in this state.

EXPIRED: The sharing relationship has expired.

REVOKED: The sharing relationship was revoked by the sharer.

INVALID: The sharing relationship is invalid. This can happen if the source dataset is deleted
Status.description_zh:
分享状态：
ACTIVE：分享关系正常可用，仅该状态下会展示完整的数据集信息
EXPIRED: 分享超过预设的有效期
REVOKED: 分享被主动取消(分享者手动撤销分享)
INVALID：分享因系统原因自动失效(如源数据集被删除)
Status.title:
分享状态：
● active：分享关系正常可用，仅该状态下会展示完整的数据集信息
● expired: 分享超过预设的有效期
● revoked: 分享被主动取消(分享者手动撤销分享)
● invalid：分享因系统原因自动失效(如源数据集被删除)

TenantId.description_en:
The ID of the target tenant. This must be a root account ID.

This parameter is required when you set a sharing relationship
TenantId.description_zh:
目标租户ID，必须为主账号ID。
设置分享关系时必填
TenantId.title: 目标租户ID

WorkspaceId.description_en:
The ID of the target workspace. This ID must be different from the source workspace ID.

This parameter is required when you set a sharing relationship
WorkspaceId.description_zh:
目标工作空间ID。需与源数据集工作空间ID不同。

设置分享关系时必填
WorkspaceId.title: 目标工作空间ID

Key.description_en: The label key. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
Key.description_zh: 标签的key。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
Key.title: 标签的key

Value.description_en: The label value. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
Value.description_zh: 标签的value。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
Value.title: 标签的value

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For information about how to obtain the dataset ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

Accessibility.description_en:
The workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Only the dataset owner and administrators in the workspace can access the dataset.
PUBLIC: All members in the workspace can access the dataset.
ROLE_PUBLIC: Only specified workspace roles can access the dataset. For the role list, see AccessibleRoleIdList. The dataset owner and administrators always have access under this condition
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见度。可能值：
PRIVATE：表示工作空间内仅数据集所有者以及管理员可见。
PUBLIC：工作空间全体成员可见。
ROLE_PUBLIC: 指定工作空间角色可见，角色列表参考：AccessibleRoleIdList。该条件下数据集所有者及管理员始终具备可见性

AccessibleRoleIdList.description_en: The list of workspace role names that can access the dataset. This field takes effect when Accessibility is ROLE_PUBLIC. IDs starting with PAI are basic role IDs, and IDs starting with role- are custom role IDs
AccessibleRoleIdList.description_zh: 在Accessibility为ROLE_PUBLIC时生效。该数据集可见的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID

DataSourceType.description_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
OSS: Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS).
NAS: Alibaba Cloud Apsara File Storage NAS (NAS)
DataSourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型。可能值：
OSS：阿里云对象存储（OSS）。
NAS：阿里云文件存储（NAS）

DataType.description_en:
The data type of the dataset. Valid values:

COMMON: common.
PIC: image.
TEXT: text.
VIDEO: video.
AUDIO: audio
DataType.description_zh:
数据集的数据类型，可能值：

COMMON：普通。
PIC：图片。
TEXT：文本。
VIDEO：视频。
AUDIO：音频

Edition.description_en:
The dataset type. Valid values:

BASIC: Basic. Does not support dataset file metadata management.

 

ADVANCED: Advanced. Only supported for OSS type. Each version supports metadata management for up to 1 million files
Edition.description_zh:
数据集类型。枚举值：

BASIC：基础型。不支持数据集文件元数据管理。

 

ADVANCED：高级型。仅OSS类型支持，每个版本支持最多100万个文件元数据管理

ImportInfo.description_en:
The storage import configuration of the dataset. OSS, NAS, and CPFS are supported.
OSS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"bucket": "${bucket}",//Bucket name
"path": "${path}" //File path
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"path": "${path}", //File system path
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //File system mount target
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", //File system protocol service
"exportId": "${export_id}", //File system export directory
"path": "${path}", //File system path
}
Lingjun CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"path": "${path}", //File system path
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //File system mount target, specific to Lingjun edition
"isVpcMount": boolean, //Whether it is a VPC mount target, specific to Lingjun edition
}
ImportInfo.description_zh:
数据集的存储导入配置信息，支持OSS/NAS/CPFS等。
OSS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"bucket": "${bucket}",//bucket名称
"path": "${path}" //文件路径
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", //文件系统协议服务
"exportId": "${export_id}", //文件系统导出目录
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
}
智算CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点，智算版特有
"isVpcMount": boolean, //是否为vpc挂载点, 智算版特有
}

IsShared.description_en: Indicates whether the dataset is a shared dataset

items.description_en: The label added to the dataset

LatestVersion.description_en: The latest version of the dataset

MountAccess.description_en:
The permission when the dataset is mounted. Valid values:
RO: read-only mount.
RW: read-write mount
MountAccess.description_zh:
该数据集被挂载时的权限。
RO：只读挂载
RW：读写挂载

MountAccessReadWriteRoleIdList.description_en: The list of workspace role names that have read and write permission on the dataset. IDs starting with PAI are basic role IDs, and IDs starting with role- are custom role IDs. If the list contains "*", all roles have read and write permission
MountAccessReadWriteRoleIdList.description_zh: 具有该数据集读写权限的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID。如果列表中包含了"*"，则表示对所有角色都有读写权限

Options.description_en:
The extension field of the initial version v1, in JsonString format.
When DLC uses the dataset, you can specify the default mount path of the dataset by configuring the mountPath field
Options.description_zh:
初始版本v1的扩展字段，JsonString类型。
当DLC使用数据集时，可通过配置mountPath字段指定数据集默认挂载路径

Property.description_en:
The property of the initial dataset version v1. Valid values:
FILE: file.
DIRECTORY: folder
Property.description_zh:
数据集初始版本v1的属性。可能值：
FILE：文件。
DIRECTORY：文件夹

Provider.description_en: The dataset provider. If the value is "pai", the dataset is a PAI platform public dataset
Provider.description_zh: 数据集提供方。返回值为"pai"时表示该数据集为PAI平台的公共数据集

ProviderType.description_en:
The data source provider type of the dataset. Valid values:
Ecs (default)
Lingjun
ProviderType.description_zh:
数据集的数据源来源类型。取值如下：
Ecs （默认）
Lingjun

SharedFrom.description_en: The source relationship of the shared dataset. This field is valid only when IsShared is true
SharedFrom.description_zh: 描述该分享数据集的来源关系。仅IsShared为true时有效

SharingConfig.description_en: The sharing configuration of the current dataset
SharingConfig.description_zh: 当前数据集的分享配置信息

SharedTo.description_en: The list of sharing configuration relationships

items.description_en: The sharing configuration relationship of the dataset
items.description_zh: 该数据集被分享的分享配置关系

SourceDatasetId.description_en: The source dataset ID of the iTag labeling dataset

SourceDatasetVersion.description_en: The source dataset version of the labeling dataset
SourceDatasetVersion.description_zh: 标注数据集的来源数据集版本

SourceId.description_en:
The source ID of the initial version v1. Valid values:
If SourceType is USER, SourceId can be customized.
If SourceType is ITAG, which indicates a dataset generated from iTAG labeling results, SourceId is the iTAG task ID.
If SourceType is PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET, which indicates a dataset created from a PAI public dataset, SourceId is empty by default
SourceId.description_zh:
初始版本v1的数据来源ID，可能值：
当SourceType为USER时，SourceId支持自定义。
当SourceType为ITAG时，即iTAG模块标注结果生成的数据集时，SourceId为ITAG的任务ID。
当SourceType为PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET时，即使用PAI公共数据集创建的数据集时，SourceId默认为空

SourceType.description_en: The source type of the initial version v1
SourceType.description_zh: 数据来源初始版本v1的类型

TagTemplateType.description_en: The labeling template of the iTag labeling dataset
TagTemplateType.description_zh: iTag标注数据集的标注模板

Uri.description_en:
The URI of the initial version v1. Example formats:
If the data source type is OSS: `oss://bucket.endpoint/object`.
If the data source type is NAS:
General-purpose NAS format: `nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`.
CPFS 1.0: `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`.
CPFS 2.0: `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`.
CPFS 1.0 and CPFS 2.0 are distinguished by the format of the fsid:
CPFS 1.0 format: cpfs-<8 ASCII characters>.
CPFS 2.0 format: cpfs-<16 ASCII characters>
Uri.description_zh:
初始版本v1的Uri，样例格式：
数据源类型为OSS：`oss://bucket.endpoint/object`。
数据源类型为NAS：
通用型NAS格式为：`nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS1.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS2.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`；
CPFS1.0和CPFS2.0根据fsid的格式来区分：
CPFS1.0 格式为cpfs-<8位ascii字符>；
CPFS2.0 格式为cpfs-<16为ascii字符>

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user to whom the dataset belongs

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the dataset belongs
